# Quick Note brand icon attribution

Sheetlog renders every curated Quick Note brand from a public or supplied source asset. Source SVG geometry is used directly; monochrome source SVGs are colourised with the brand colour already defined in Sheetlog. The compact marks from PR #244 remain as loading, offline, and source-error fallbacks.
